name: Russia–Ukraine
value: 162 drones overnight to 10 Nov; talks open
summary: Zaporizhzhia plant lost off-site power on 8 Nov; Russia launched 162 drones overnight to 10 Nov as Abu Dhabi talks began
state: Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant lost external power on 8 Nov, its 27th loss of off-site power in the war, before it was restored (ThePrint, Reuters); this safety incident sets the Alert. Russia launched 162 drones and a ballistic missile overnight to 10 Nov, and strikes killed at least 18 people collecting aid in Komyshuvakha on 2 Nov, Ukraine said (PBS; Asharq Al-Awsat). US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi on 10 Nov lasted about four hours, with a second day set for 11 Nov.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice: it advises against all travel to Ukraine. Energy and grain markets remain sensitive to the war.
rubric_hit: Nuclear-plant safety incident (ZNPP off-site power loss 8 Nov) = Alert
